planSummary: Typed boundary hardening wave for SliceCloseRuntime while preserving source-run CLI compatibility, slice-close behavior, ASK commit provenance, OHDER governance, rollback, entropy, and pre-push semantics.

slices.title: 001 Current Behavior Characterization
slices.description: Characterize current SliceCloseRuntime behavior before helper extraction.
acceptanceCriteria: Successful close still auto-completes the task, creates an ASK-Slice commit, runs pre-push, emits OHDER and entropy events, and records loop state.
Dirty index still fails before task completion.
OHDER block still leaves task in-progress and creates no commit.
Commit failure still rolls task back to in-progress.
Pre-push failure after commit still leaves task completed.
Integrator or protected lanes still require the full suite.

slices.title: 002 Slice Close TypeScript Contracts
slices.description: Add TypeScript-facing interfaces and fixtures for current slice-close result payloads without changing runtime output.
acceptanceCriteria: Contracts represent success and failure payloads without changing runtime output.
Contract fixtures compile under current TypeScript settings.
Existing check and governance contract exports remain backward-compatible.
No runtime JavaScript imports TypeScript contract files directly.

slices.title: 003 Typed Helper Boundary
slices.description: Create SliceCloseRuntimeHelpers.ts and move only pure helper behavior into typed helpers while leaving SliceCloseRuntime.js unchanged in this slice.
acceptanceCriteria: SliceCloseRuntimeHelpers.ts exports normalizeSliceCloseValue, toSliceCloseBoolean, toSliceCloseNumber, normalizeSliceCloseLower, parseSliceCloseList, riskFromArchitectureScore, entropyDimensionsFromArchitectResult, parseGitStatusPath, resolveSliceCloseSummary, and isRefactorGovernedSliceTask.

Helper contract tests cover trimming, lower-casing, boolean parsing, numeric fallback, comma-list parsing, git status path parsing, refactor task detection, lane summary rendering, and entropy dimensions.
Source inspection confirms no runtime JavaScript imports SliceCloseRuntimeHelpers.ts.
SliceCloseRuntime.js remains unchanged in this slice.

slices.title: 004 JS Mirror Runtime Delegation
slices.description: Create SliceCloseRuntimeHelpers.js and refactor SliceCloseRuntime.js to delegate pure helper behavior through the source-compatible JS mirror.
acceptanceCriteria: SliceCloseRuntime.js imports from ./SliceCloseRuntimeHelpers.js, not .ts.
Removed inline helper definitions are replaced by equivalent helper calls.
Public CLI behavior and payload shape are unchanged.
Existing slice-close contract tests pass.
Helper tests prove the JS mirror behavior matches typed helper expectations.

slices.title: 005 Migration Status Update
slices.description: Update TypeScript migration status for the completed SliceCloseRuntime TypeScript Boundary Hardening wave.
acceptanceCriteria: ask-ts-006 says SliceCloseRuntime boundary hardening is complete for this wave.
Docs include a SliceCloseRuntime TypeScript Boundary Hardening Wave section.
Docs state SliceCloseRuntime.js remains source-compatible JavaScript while pure helpers are typed and mirrored.
Next Recommended Implementation Sequence moves to law-pack/profile runtime conversion.
Docs preserve contracts-first, runtime-conversion-later, strictness-last framing.
